description: This file defines the SearchQueryResults activity class for an Android application. It handles search intents, processes search queries, displays query information, and records recent searches.

classes.name: SearchQueryResults
classes.description: An Android Activity that handles search queries, displays search results, and records recent searches.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up UI, and processes incoming search intent if present.

methods.name: onNewIntent
methods.description: Handles new intents delivered to the activity, particularly new search actions.

methods.name: doSearchQuery
methods.description: Processes the search query, updates UI with query info, and saves recent search.
